post.description:
Provisions a Nevermined identity (and Privy-managed wallet) for the given email under the caller's organization. The `as` field selects the outcome:

- `member` (default): adds a seat-consuming `OrganizationMember` with the requested role (defaults to Member), starting inactive pending an email-challenge confirmation. Returns 201 when the membership was created, or 200 when the user is already a member.
- `customer`: **white-label onboarding** — no seat is consumed. `role` is ignored. The behaviour depends on whether the email already has a Nevermined identity:
  - **new account**: recorded into the organization Customers CRM immediately (before any purchase) and the response returns a usable, scoped NVM API key (`walletResult.nvmApiKey`, 201) so the organization can transparently act for its own customer. The key is tagged to the caller's organization, so the customer's requests resolve to that workspace and their activity/purchases are attributed to it.
  - **existing account**: no key is issued (account-takeover guard). An email challenge is sent to the owner and the response is `202` with `walletResult.consentRequired = true`; the organization cannot obtain a credential for an account it does not own without the owner’s consent.

Requires a Nevermined API key and organization admin privileges.

requestBody.description: Email to provision, and the onboarding outcome (`as`).

200.description: User was already a member of the organization; returns the existing wallet info.

201.description: Account provisioned. For `as=member`: added as an inactive member. For `as=customer` with a NEW account: recorded into the Customers CRM (no seat) with a usable scoped `nvmApiKey` returned.

nvmApiKey.description: Usable, scoped NVM API key (Bearer credential). Present only for a NEW-account `as=customer`.

isCustomer.description: True when provisioned via the white-label customer outcome (new account).

customerRecorded.description: Whether the customer was written to the Customers CRM. False signals a best-effort write failed (the customer is still provisioned and keyed).

202.description: `as=customer` for an EXISTING account the caller does not own: no credential issued and the account's identity is deliberately NOT disclosed (opaque). An email challenge was sent to the owner; `walletResult.consentRequired = true`. Onboarding completes once the owner consents.

A new URL is revalidated against the SSRF guard. The response omits the signing secret. Requires a Nevermined API key. Requires organization admin privileges. Requires the organization to be on the Premium tier or higher.

Signatures computed with the old secret stop verifying as soon as this returns. The new plaintext secret is returned ONCE in the response and is never retrievable again. info.title: Nevermined Organizations API
info.description: Manage a Nevermined organization programmatically — members, tiers, groups & budgets, treasury wallets, customers, webhooks, analytics, and agent-discovery surfaces.

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Organization settings, members & roles, and workspace context.

tags.name: Organizations - Billing
tags.description: Tiers, subscriptions, invoices, checkout, and the public tier catalog.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Organization groups, per-group budgets, and shared payment methods.

tags.name: Organizations - Analytics
tags.description: Revenue, MRR, usage, conversion, and per-member metrics.

code.description: Error code identifier (e.g., BCK.PROTOCOL.0001, BCK.X402.0005). NOTE: any endpoint may also return a framework-level `BCK.HTTP.<status>` code (e.g. `BCK.HTTP.400` from request validation, `BCK.HTTP.429` from throttling, `BCK.HTTP.404`) — these are emitted by the global fallback filter for HTTP errors that carry no domain-specific code. Clients must tolerate them.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong

details.description: Throw-site detail string supplementing the canonical message. Only set when the call site supplied an opts.message; absent otherwise.
details.example: Hash JWT is not signed by the node account

hint.description: Actionable remediation hint, sourced from the catalogue or supplied at the throw site. Tells the caller what to fix or where to look.
hint.example: Verify the wallet has sufficient balance and that the plan is active.

docsUrl.description: Permalink to the docs page describing this error code.

category.description: Coarse classification of the failure, useful for client-side branching without parsing the message.

retryable.description: Whether the failure is transient and the same call can be retried with identical inputs. Absent when the catalogue does not assert either way.

correlationId.description: Request-scoped correlation id stamped by the global filter. Echoed in the x-correlation-id response header. Quote this when reporting issues.

uuid.description: Per-error UUID generated at construction. Useful for log correlation.

date.description: ISO timestamp at which the error was constructed.

params.description: JSON-stringified contextual parameters supplied at the throw site (e.g. IDs, state). Always a string in the wire format — parse with JSON.parse if needed.

cryptoFees.description: Fee percentage for crypto payments (as decimal, e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

fiatFees.description: Fee percentage for fiat payments (as decimal, e.g., 0.05 for 5%)

isActive.description: Active status of the organization member

page.description: Page of the organization members list

offset.description: Page offset of the organization members list

environment.description: Environment to get stripe account id from (live or sandbox)

stripeAccountId.description: Stripe account ID for the current environment

members.description: List of organization members with profile information

offset.description: Page offset of the notifications list

totalActiveAdmins.description: Total number of ACTIVE admins in the organization (not just on this page). Used by the webapp to guard "demote / deactivate / remove last admin" actions when the relevant admin sits on a different page than the viewer.

slug.description: Unique DNS-safe label for the org subdomain (`<slug>.api.nevermined.app`). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen.

description.description: Short description that will be shown publicly

isActive.description: Whether the organization is active. If set to false, all members will also be deactivated.

cryptoFees.description: Fee percentage for crypto payments, multiplied by 10000 (e.g., 1500 = 15%)

fiatFees.description: Fee percentage for fiat payments, multiplied by 10000 (e.g., 1500 = 15%)

remainingBudgetCents.description: The TEAM's shared remaining budget for this currency this period, in minor units, floored at 0. Shared by every active group member — the team ceiling, NOT a personal allowance.

groupId.description: The caller's active group ID in this org.

budgets.description: The TEAM's shared remaining budgets, one entry per configured currency. An EMPTY array means the group has NO budget configured; an ABSENT field means the budgets could not be read (unknown — do NOT treat as 'no cap'; the ceiling is still enforced at charge time).

role.description: Role of the authenticated user in this organization

isAdmin.description: Whether the user is an admin of this organization

hasSubscriptionHistory.description: True when the org has at least one organizationSubscription row — i.e. the org has previously been associated with a paid tier (active, past_due, trialing, lapsed, or canceled). Combined with `orgType === Lapsed` it distinguishes "subscription expired" (block resource creation) from "free org that never subscribed" (allow within free caps).

group.description: The caller's active group in this org plus its shared team budget, so a buyer/agent can see the team cap before spending. `null` when the caller belongs to no active group.

valid.description: Whether the user is allowed to use the requested org as their workspace context

currentOrgId.description: The org ID that was validated, or null for personal context

role.description: Role of the user in the organization
New role for the member. Only Admin or Member are permitted.

eventType.description: The type of event that occurred

actorUserId.description: The user ID of the actor who triggered the event, or null for system events

subject.description: The resource the event is about: { kind, id, ...extra }

metadata.description: Optional extra payload (e.g. role change before/after)

items.description: Page of activity events ordered by occurredAt DESC

total.description: Total number of events matching the filter (across all pages)

totalRevenue.description: Total revenue attributed to this agent, serialised as a string (bigint).
Aggregate revenue across all agents, serialised as a string (bigint).

mrr.description: Monthly recurring revenue, serialised as a string (bigint).

creditsBurned.description: Total credits burned against this plan, serialised as a string (bigint).

uniqueUsers.description: Number of distinct users who burned credits.

userId.description: Nevermined user ID of the customer.

totalSpent.description: Total amount the customer has spent, serialised as a string (bigint).

firstSeenAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the customer was first observed.

lastActiveAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the customer’s most recent activity.

items.description: Top customers ordered by spend DESC.

totalCustomers.description: Total number of customers in the organization.

sessions.description: Number of sessions observed in the period.

purchases.description: Number of purchases observed in the period.

conversionRate.description: Conversion rate (purchases / sessions). `null` when no sessions were observed in the period — clients should render an empty state ("No data yet") rather than 0.

totalCreditsBurned.description: Total credits burned by this member, serialised as a string (bigint).

burnCount.description: Number of burn operations attributed to the member.

lastBurnAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the member’s most recent burn, or `null` if none in the period.

totalAmount.description: Total spend in the asset's atomic units, serialised as a string.

paymentCount.description: Number of router payments in this asset/network.

amount.description: Charged amount in the asset's atomic units (string).

totalsByAsset.description: Per-asset spend totals. Token atomic units are NOT additive across assets, so totals are reported per (asset, network) rather than as one cross-asset number.

items.description: The group's most-recent router payments in the window.

tier.description: Target tier for the downgrade. Premium is the only valid downgrade target.
Target tier for the upgrade. Enterprise is the only valid in-place upgrade target.
Target tier to subscribe the organization to.

currency.description: Currency for the purchase. Accepted for backward compatibility but currently ignored — checkout always resolves to USD.

interval.description: Billing interval. Accepted for backward compatibility but currently ignored — checkout always resolves to a monthly interval.

purchases.description: Number of purchases in this bucket.

amount.description: Sum of prices for purchases in this bucket, serialised as a string (bigint).

customerCount.description: Total customers ever seen for this org.

purchaseCount.description: Count of purchase transactions in range.

totalSpent.description: Sum of purchase prices in range, serialised as a string (bigint).

userId.description: Nevermined user ID of the customer.

firstSeenAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the customer was first observed.

lastActiveAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the customer’s most recent activity.

totalSpent.description: Total amount the customer has spent, serialised as a string (bigint).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the customer record was created.

status.description: Lifecycle status. `blocked` customers hold no valid org-issued credential and cannot be issued a new one until unblocked.

userName.description: Display name from the buyer’s user profile, when available.

userEmail.description: Email from the buyer’s user profile, when available.

purchaseCount.description: Count of purchase transactions in range.

totalSpent.description: Sum of purchase prices in range, serialised as a string (bigint).

price.description: Plan price paid, serialised as a string (bigint).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the purchase was recorded.

total.description: Total purchase rows across all pages.

spendingLimitCents.description: Spend ceiling for the period, in minor units (cents of `currency`).

currency.description: Currency of this budget (one budget per currency per group). Defaults to usd. Enforcement matches the charge currency exactly — a usd budget does NOT cap usdc spend.

alertThresholdPct.description: Alert when spend crosses this % of the limit

maxTransactions.description: Optional cap on the number of charges per period

spendingLimitCents.description: Spend ceiling for the period (minor units)

alertThresholdPct.description: Alert when spend crosses this % of the limit

maxTransactions.description: Optional cap on the number of charges per period

paymentMethodId.description: Id of an org card to share with the group — the card's provider payment-method id (the same id the /payment-methods list, PATCH and revoke use), not the internal row id.

memberCount.description: Count of active members in the group

memberId.description: The organization member id (`om-…`) to add to the group.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

name.description: Display name of the invitee. Used to greet them in the email.

role.description: Role to assign in the organization

orgId.description: Organization ID the user was added to

label.description: Human-readable label for the secret, e.g. "MacBook ops".

secret.description: Plaintext secret — shown ONCE. Copy it now; it is never retrievable again.

lastFour.description: Last 4 chars (the dashboard masks it as wss_…XXXX).

label.description: Optional human label for the wallet (e.g. "Treasury").

amount.description: Amount in the token’s smallest unit (6-decimal atomic units).

OrganizationActivityEventType.description: Event types this subscription should receive. Omit or pass an empty array to subscribe to all event types.

url.description: Destination URL that receives the signed webhook POST. Must be an https:// URL in production (http:// is only accepted when the server explicitly allows it for development). The host must not resolve to a private, loopback, link-local, or cloud-metadata address (SSRF guard).

eventTypes.description: Event types this subscription should receive. Omit or pass an empty array to subscribe to all event types.

description.description: Optional human-readable label shown in the dashboard.

url.description: New destination URL. Subject to the same https:// and SSRF validation as on create.

eventTypes.description: Replacement list of event types. An empty array subscribes to all event types.

enabled.description: Enable or disable delivery. When false, the dispatcher skips this subscription.

description.description: Updated human-readable label shown in the dashboard.

details.description: Throw-site detail string supplementing the canonical message. Only set when the call site supplied an opts.message; absent otherwise.
details.example: Hash JWT is not signed by the node account

hint.description: Actionable remediation hint, sourced from the catalogue or supplied at the throw site. Tells the caller what to fix or where to look.
hint.example: Verify the wallet has sufficient balance and that the plan is active.

docsUrl.description: Permalink to the docs page describing this error code.

category.description: Coarse classification of the failure, useful for client-side branching without parsing the message.

retryable.description: Whether the failure is transient and the same call can be retried with identical inputs. Absent when the catalogue does not assert either way.

correlationId.description: Request-scoped correlation id stamped by the global filter. Echoed in the x-correlation-id response header. Quote this when reporting issues.

uuid.description: Per-error UUID generated at construction. Useful for log correlation.

date.description: ISO timestamp at which the error was constructed.
